REG: Trial registries with POSTED RESULTS: EU Clinical Trials Register (EudraCT) results tab and EU CTIS public results; ISRCTN results; ANZCTR results; jRCT / JPRN (UMIN-CTR results); DRKS; CTRI; ChiCTR; WHO ICTRP (use it to find secondary IDs, then the national registry); ClinicalTrials.gov posted results and the CT.gov 'Documents' (protocol / SAP / results PDFs) for any NCT.
SPONSOR: Sponsor and data-sharing registers: GSK study register (CSR synopses), Novartis clinical trial results, Roche/Genentech (forpatients.roche.com and Roche clinical trial results), Lilly, Pfizer (pfizer.com trial results / CSR synopses), AstraZeneca (astrazenecaclinicaltrials.com), Sanofi (sanofi.com clinical trial results), Boehringer Ingelheim, Bayer, Novo Nordisk, Amgen, Regeneron; and listings on Vivli, YODA, ClinicalStudyDataRequest (CSDR) -- a LISTING is not data: record whether per-arm results are openly readable without an account.
REGULATOR: Regulators: EMA EPAR and EPAR assessment reports (ema.europa.eu), EMA clinical data portal (listing only; it needs an EMA account -- record BLOCKED_ACCOUNT, never register), Health Canada clinical information portal (search listing only; documents sit behind a terms page -- record BLOCKED_TERMS, never accept), FDA: Drugs@FDA medical / statistical / summary reviews (accessdata.fda.gov drugsatfda_docs, including supplement reviews), FDA Advisory Committee briefing documents (fda.gov/media), FDA Drug Trials Snapshots, FDA EUA review memos; PMDA English review reports; TGA AusPARs; MHRA PARs (products.mhra.gov.uk); Swissmedic SwissPARs.
HTA: HTA bodies: G-BA (g-ba.de) dossier Module 4 and IQWiG (iqwig.de) dossier assessments / extracts; NICE committee papers incl. company submissions and EAG/ERG reports; Scottish Medicines Consortium (SMC) advice; HAS transparency committee opinions (has-sante.fr); CDA-AMC/CADTH reports (cda-amc.ca serves a bot challenge -- never solve it; NCBI litarch https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/litarch/file_list.csv lists CADTH reports as downloadable packages, but note CADTH redacts sponsor data with black blocks); PBAC public summary documents (pbs.gov.au); ICER evidence reports (icer.org).
EVIDENCE: Evidence reports with per-trial tables: AHRQ EPC reports (effectivehealthcare.ahrq.gov; also NCBI litarch packages published by 'Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (US)'), NIHR Journals Library HTA monographs (open access), Cochrane reviews' 'characteristics of included studies' and analysis data where free to read, Epistemonikos, WHO guideline evidence profiles / GRADE tables (incl. WHO COVID-19 living guidance). NOTE: these are SECONDARY sources (another reviewer's extraction); record them, flagged secondary.
LIT: Literature: Europe PMC (full text where open, and supplementary files), OpenAlex + Unpaywall OA copies (record the licence string), medRxiv/bioRxiv preprints, open conference-abstract supplements (e.g. journal supplement issues), and the trial's own published primary paper / secondary analyses if open access.
